requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop NGB keyed bottles for the Magellan printer with 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, and >8,000-page size for CMY.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure high page yield and compatibility with the new printer, reducing user intervention and supporting high-volume printing.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on new bottle design and compatibility with existing ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are available for Black and CMY; Black yields 6,000 pages, CMY bottles are >8,000-page size, and bottles are keyed for system compatibility.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure new NGB bottles provide spill-free reliability when used with the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and minimize mess or ink wastage during refilling.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle and ink system integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No spills occur during bottle installation or removal in 100% of test cases across 100 cycles.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label; maintain current click on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance reliability and maintain established user experience features.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design update, compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units include metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to push-push and TDF mechanisms, verified in production samples.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink formulations without requiring ink reformulation for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development time, leverage proven technology, and minimize risk.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility verification with new printer system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink operate within performance specs in the Magellan system with no reformulation required.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F units must be available as service parts for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure serviceability and maintain warranty commitments for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F service parts are available and supplied for warranty claims within standard SLA.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature into the printer lid.
requirements.Rationale: To support advanced features or security as per platform standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Lid design update and platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 feature is operational and tested on the production lid.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 factory line for NOA-F, and add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: To enable efficient manufacturing of the new printer and consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Capex approval, tool procurement, line reconfiguration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line is modified and operational for NOA-F; Magi ink cart and labelling tool are installed in Orcus 5.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design Magellan printer to allow customer-replaceable PHA and NOA-F units.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user serviceability and reduce support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical design for easy access and replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F without tools in under 5 minutes, verified by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Set new warranty page life goal for Magellan printer at 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market expectations for durability and reduce warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and consumables function to spec for 80,000 pages under standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID for Magellan with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink capacity while maintaining design identity.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design update, compatibility with Reddington ID.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased as per spec, Reddington ID is maintained, and ADF unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printer meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with environmental regulations and market requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with increased tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and optimize product footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit and operate correctly with new tank design; printer passes mechanical fit and finish tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD display into the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To provide a modern and user-friendly interface.
requirements.Dependencies: Electrical and mechanical integration of display.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display is functional, passes UI and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: 4-Tube Platform with New Tube Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes for a 4-tube platform, with new tube routing and integration for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink delivery and system reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design and routing, system integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four tubes are routed and integrated per design, system passes ink delivery and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for aerosol management with spit platform changes due to new tank.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure proper aerosol handling and maintain print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and tank design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service station manages aerosols effectively, verified by print quality and emissions testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation and print quality with new system configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and dynamic parameters with new tubes and weights in testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Durability for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Enhance paper path to support increased page life of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure printer reliability over its extended life expectancy.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path component selection and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no significant wear after 80,000 pages in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Provide ink maintenance as a serviceable part at service centers after 80,000-page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: To extend printer service life and reduce total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced at service centers post-80k life, verified by service procedures.

requirements.Title: 140ml Black Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Provide 140ml Black bottles and new capacity CMY bottles for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher print volumes and reduce refill frequency.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, End Users, Supply Chain
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design and supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 140ml Black bottles and new CMY bottles are available and compatible with Magellan system.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Implement a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery system performance and startup reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup algorithm passes performance and reliability tests; air management is verified in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new servicing and startup algorithm for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and user experience during initial setup and servicing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Servicing and startup algorithm passes reliability and usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality goals and depletion criteria to align with page yield definition for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure print quality and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets new goals and depletion is defined and measured per updated criteria.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven electronics and reduce development cost and risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components operate to spec in Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module into Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To provide wireless connectivity as per current standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module is operational and passes connectivity and compliance tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune and Gauss4.xx Security Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate FW Dune and Gauss4.xx security features into Magellan printer (hardware and firmware).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure security compliance and protect user data.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware integration, compliance testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: FW Dune and Gauss4.xx security features are operational and pass security validation tests.

requirements.Title: Business Model Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Magellan must support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments, including PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize market reach and adapt to diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is offered in configurations and bundles supporting the specified segments and services.

requirements.Title: Solution Integration: Scan, SMB Manageability, Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance solution offering and address business customer requirements.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business, R&D, Product Management, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed solutions are functional and pass integration and user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Provide client and driver support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure broad compatibility and ease of use across platforms and customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are available, tested, and documented for Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt-LE/Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Leverage Watt-LE/Marconi Hi mechanical platform and integrate with CISS for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development cost and time to market while incorporating CISS benefits.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Watt-LE/Marconi Hi Mech platform is used and CISS is integrated and passes system tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule as Least Flexible Constraint
requirements.Description: Meet the schedule as the highest business constraint for Magellan program.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure timely market entry and competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All program milestones are met as per published schedule.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K as Least Flexible Constraint
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a life of at least 65,000 pages for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliability and meet business constraints for consumable life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA is verified to last at least 65,000 pages in standard test cycles.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must be warranted for 2 years or up to the page life goal, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To align with market expectations and business priorities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product warranty is offered for 2 years or 80,000 pages, with support processes in place.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL) as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must achieve throughput of 25 ppm (mono) and 20 ppm (color) for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To meet performance requirements and market competitiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25 ppm mono and 20 ppm color in PDL SKU during standard performance tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Design Magellan printer for easy servicing of the maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: To improve post-sale support and reduce downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical design for access and replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced or replaced within 10 minutes by service personnel.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Magellan must support SMB solutions as an optimized business priority.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure the printer meets the needs of small and medium business customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solutions are available and functional for Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: PaaS Schedule as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Ensure PaaS (Printing as a Service) is delivered according to schedule for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To support new business models and revenue streams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS is available for Magellan as per published schedule and passes customer acceptance.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK as Flexible Priority
requirements.Description: Provide support for hosting 12K-CMYK as a flexible business priority.
requirements.Rationale: To allow for future scalability and market adaptation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System design can accommodate 12K-CMYK hosting if required in future roadmap.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K as Flexible Priority
requirements.Description: Support trade page 6K as a flexible business priority.
requirements.Rationale: To provide options for market-specific or promotional SKUs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trade page 6K option is available as a configurable SKU.
